variant.author: BardToolbox
variant.changelog:
Integrated Macrology into BardToolbox as a full modern UI category. The Macrology Quick Bar can now be embedded in the BTB Quick Controller or opened as its own pop-out window. Added an optional broadcast mode that compiles and sends a macro to every connected local BTB client, including parameter values, submacros, breakpoints, run mode, and safety settings. Added /mmbroadcast for explicit all-client runs and one-time import of an existing standalone Macrology configuration.

Dalamud API 15.
